title: descurainia pinnata subsp. brachycarpon
intro: Descurainia pinnata subsp. brachycarpon, commonly known as Western Pasque Flower, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to provide relief from various health issues. The plant is known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help in soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and protecting against infections. The bioactive constituents of Western Pasque Flower include glucosinolates, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
